units.source_scale_reason: Reviewed source-resolution registration; one anatomical scale per original image.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed complete chronological original sequences, enlarged hands/cord bells/feet/alpha edges, and every selected native 128px battle phase. Visible elbow and bell idle; three reciprocal walking cycles; far-hand single-bell melee; corrected low near-hand paired-bell ranged cast with matching clean recovery; distinct held crouched guard; recoil and recovery; standing shoulder-level physical bell signal; grounded side collapse and corpse. Rejected clipped v1 ranged windup and color-changing v1 support. The latter supplies only one safely blue-keyed guide for the stable-background v2 replacement. Both bells, short cords and teal ribbons remain coherent. Continuous video playback, manual game playtest and Linux validation were not performed.
